purpose: Separate the deterministic Chan path grammar, causal confirmation conventions, unresolved source ambiguities, quantitative divergence coordinates, and empirical profit hypotheses before any return study.

source_corpus.role: Primary public lesson-by-lesson cross-check. Attributed replies are supporting context; later editor notes are not definitions.

epistemic_classes.strict_definition: A geometric relation stated sufficiently clearly to encode directly.
epistemic_classes.engineering_convention: A causal or data-system choice needed for an online implementation but not uniquely selected by the source.
epistemic_classes.ambiguity_variant: A source-compatible alternative that must remain separately measurable.
epistemic_classes.quantitative_coordinate: A numerical representation of an under-specified qualitative concept; no variant is treated as the true measure.
epistemic_classes.empirical_hypothesis: A claim about future paths, execution, or profit that the parser cannot prove.

causal_contract.event_time: The source-bar timestamp of the structural extreme or boundary event.
causal_contract.confirmation_time: The first timestamp at which all bars and lower-level structures required by the selected rule are locked.
causal_contract.writeback: A later confirmation is emitted on its confirmation timestamp and is never written into an earlier feature row.
causal_contract.provisional_state: The last inclusion-normalized bar, the last accepted stroke, and unresolved gap segment breaks remain provisional.
causal_contract.downstream_locking: Segments consume only strokes locked by a following accepted stroke; this conservative delay prevents a later same-kind fractal from rewriting a consumed endpoint.

data_contract.price_adjustment: Multiply raw intraday OHLC by the same-day cumulative adjust_factor. Do not use a future-normalized forward-adjustment factor.
data_contract.missingness: A positive-volume daily bar without a complete canonical 48-bar intraday day breaks the parser episode. Suspension-only gaps do not fabricate bars and do not by themselves break the episode.
data_contract.manifest_date_policy: Shard date metadata is audited but date filtering uses the actual Parquet trade_date column because some installed archive shard metadata is malformed.

definitions.rule: A canonical, complete, adjusted five-minute OHLCV bar with a unique symbol, trade_date, and bar_time key.
Process containment sequentially. In an up context keep the larger high and larger low; in a down context keep the smaller high and smaller low.
definitions.confirmation: locked when the first raw bar of the next non-inclusive normalized bar arrives

definitions.rule: A top has a middle normalized bar with both high and low above both neighbors; a bottom has both below.
definitions.confirmation: when the right normalized neighbor is locked

definitions.rule: Connect alternating top and bottom fractals under the selected separation and price-overlap rule; retain the more extreme same-kind endpoint while the stroke is provisional.
definitions.confirmation: accepted at the endpoint fractal confirmation; locked for segment use by the next accepted stroke

definitions.rule: For an up-starting segment use its down strokes as feature elements; for a down-starting segment use its up strokes.
definitions.confirmation: each element uses only a locked stroke

definitions.rule: Apply ordered inclusion processing only among elements belonging to the same feature sequence.
definitions.confirmation: a standardized element is locked by the next non-inclusive feature element

definitions.rule: Inspect only top feature fractals for up segments and bottom feature fractals for down segments.
definitions.confirmation: when the right standardized feature element is locked

definitions.rule: If the first and second feature-fractal elements have no gap, the segment ends at the feature-fractal extreme.
If the first and second feature-fractal elements have a gap, require a fractal in the opposite segment's feature sequence before confirming the earlier endpoint.
Expose the first breaking stroke as unresolved until case 2 confirms or a new original-direction extreme invalidates it; do not assign it retrospectively to a completed segment.
definitions.confirmation: explicit pending, confirmed, or invalidated event

definitions.rule: At least three overlapping strokes, terminated by one of the two feature-sequence cases.
The non-empty intersection of three consecutive selected lowest-level components; segments are primary and strokes are a diagnostic alternative.
A later same-level component that continues to intersect the locked center core extends the center.
A later same-level center whose selected comparison interval is wholly above or below the prior center is a new birth.
Two successive same-level centers overlap under the selected core-interval or fluctuation-interval relation and are promoted as a higher-level overlap candidate.
Decompose between consecutive confirmed same-level centers and retain the selected decomposition mode in every object.
Apply the three-component overlap construction recursively to completed lower-level movements.
A completed movement snapshot with one same-level center and no confirmed monotone center sequence.
At least two same-level centers born monotonically in the same direction.
Compare consecutive same-direction trend legs using every frozen metric separately; never collapse them into one asserted true strength measure.
A trend-end buy or sell candidate attached to a named divergence metric and causal trend snapshot.
The first same-direction retest after a first point that does not exceed the first-point extreme.
After leaving a center, the first opposite segment whose endpoint remains outside the center core.
